subject: french
title: La Francophonie
welcome_lead: French is spoken across the world. La Francophonie unites speakers from Quebec to Senegal, Belgium to Vietnam.
meta_desc: IBDP French: la Francophonie and the French-speaking world.
final_note: French belongs to its speakers — and they are many.

concepts.def: Worldwide community of French speakers and institutions.

walkthroughs.body_html: L'OIF was founded in 1970 (Niamey Convention). It has 88 member states and observers, promoting French language and cultural diversity.
Quebecois French has distinctive vocabulary: magasiner (to shop), char (car). Loi 101 (1977) made French official.
Senegal, Cote d'Ivoire, DRC, Cameroon — French often shares space with local languages. Authors like Mariama Ba and Ahmadou Kourouma reshape it.
